title: Atrium — TBC & Loonies, 4K for Windows
author: TBC & Loonies, PRISM
notes: Breakpoint 2008, 4K intro: an atrium of galleries and railings under a starry sky, a red ribbon winding through it, all generated from boxes, by Mentor (object generator, synthesizer, rendering), Puryx (music), Blueberry and Lemmus; packed by Crinkler. Its objects are D3DXCreateBox meshes transformed through an ID3DXMatrixStack and D3DXVec3TransformCoordArray into one vertex buffer, drawn with HLSL vertex and pixel shaders (2.0). MIRAGE-WIN32 makes d3d9.dll and d3dx9_24.dll in JavaScript; PRISM's d3d9.js draws with WebGL2. It precalculates first: some 18 billion instructions, a minute or more of black screen.

prepare.note: Atrium precalculates first: some 18 billion instructions, on a black screen.
